text: A 27-slot camp store with a nicer face than a chest. Put it beside a hearth or a cradle to keep offerings, food and Spiritweave close at hand. It needs no Pulse.

pages.title: Using it
text: It is storage, not a second Tribe Hearth. Offerings that raise a tribe's standing go on the hearth itself (see [Standing](standing)); the table grants nothing.
Only the player who placed it, their camp, or anyone at all if nobody claimed it, can open it.
Hoppers and pipes can fill or empty it from every side. Crouch and right-click a face with an empty hand to change that face: Both, Input, Output or Closed.
A comparator reads how full it is. A redstone signal locks both the menu and the automation.
